doc.projectIntro: This quote covers a full CCTV system upgrade for Compact Food Solutions — replacing all existing cameras with 31× TPLink Vigi 40i Wide View 2K units and replacing the existing NVR with a TP-Link VIGI 64-channel 4K recorder, including storage drives, labour, and consumables. The scope covers hardware supply, installation, NVR configuration, monitoring app setup, management access, and end-user training. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: ONVIF / RTSP support. Full wide-view 2K resolution. Replacement for all existing cameras.
64-channel 4K network video recorder. Replacement for existing NVR.
Dedicated surveillance-grade hard drive for NVR storage.
Replace all existing cameras and NVR. Setup and configure new NVR, monitoring apps, and management access. End-user training on new system.
Cabling, mounts, connectors, and sundry installation materials.

doc.summaryNote: Quote based on Microweb (QT-007003, 2026/07/08). Full system upgrade — all existing cameras and NVR replaced. Pricing valid for 14 days.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
Supply and installation of hardware as specified. Any additional cabling or structural work required on site will be quoted separately.
Payment terms: 50% deposit on acceptance, balance on completion.
Hardware remains the property of Rocking until paid in full.
Manufacturer warranty applies to all hardware supplied.
